value.rationale: Sector choice to maximize gross-output response under common input intensity is a natural network sensitivity/design criterion. The universal impossibility in ≤3 sectors and the four-sector re-entry, robust to strictly positive complete networks, identify a genuine minimal structural boundary rather than a mere sign check. This does not imply policy welfare optimality or a generic empirical effect.
